hooks.name: Cite AWS claims
hooks.description: After editing slides or demo docs, remind the agent to ground AWS behaviour in the source lock.

action.prompt: You just edited talk or demo material. Before moving on, check AWS behavioural claims against .kiro/steering/aws-source-lock.md. Keep wording neutral per .kiro/steering/neutral-language.md. Do not invent latency, pricing, or that the demo board is a seismic/GNSS instrument. Unverified behaviour stays qualified or omitted. Prefer the aws-docs MCP server over recall.
